Callout.Name: Trespasser on Ranch Land
Callout.Message: Rancher reporting somebody on their land with a rifle.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect on foot, rifle slung, no shots fired.

Script.Line: He is walking my fence line with a rifle over his shoulder.
Nobody has been threatened. Not yet.
I have been on this land forty years. He is not supposed to be on it.

Lines.Approach: They are on the rancher land with a rifle on their shoulder. Nobody has been threatened yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
